title: A student-run club
for quantitative finance.
hero.sub: QUARCC is a student-run club in Montreal, Quebec, with members across universities and colleges as well. We give students the opportunity to learn about, and engage with, the field of quantitative finance.

title: Lectures, workshops
and a research group.
offer.sub: We host a variety of events throughout the year, including lectures, workshops and social gatherings — and run a research group for members who want to keep building.

cards.label: Lectures
cards.title: Speaker series
cards.body: Practitioners from National Bank, TD Asset Management and Mackenzie Investments on how quant works inside their desks.

cards.label: Workshops
cards.title: Hands-on sessions
cards.body: Python for data analysis, algorithmic trading and backtesting — from raw data to a working strategy.

cards.label: Research
cards.title: Research group
cards.body: Teams that manage live paper portfolios across research, development and trading.

cards.label: Social
cards.title: Gatherings
cards.body: Poker nights and Tuesday meet-ups — puzzles, chess and people who like building things.

title: Two halves, one club.
halves.sub: The club hosts events. The research group is for those who want to constantly take on new projects.

cards.label: The club
cards.title: Events & community
cards.body: Speaker series, workshops and socials — open to every student, at any level, as long as you're willing to learn.

cards.label: QRG
cards.title: Quantitative Research Group
cards.body: Advanced teams managing paper portfolios across research, development and trading, with analysts on a guided curriculum in systematic trading.
